entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Mohammad Shirazi was an Iranian military general who served as the head of the Military Office of the Supreme Leader of Iran from 1989 until his death in 2026. As a brigadier general, he was responsible for coordinating relations between senior commanders of Iran's armed forces and the supreme leader, acting as a key liaison in the country's defense and security apparatus. Shirazi was killed during the opening strikes of the 2026 Iran war.
